title: Pride beds
description: Just a very silly reasource pack that makes the beds have pride flags for sheets.
body:
A silly reasource pack that turns the textures of the beds into pride flags ffor their sheets
the colours are:
-   white - pride
-   light grey - demiboy
-   grey - demigirl
-   black - demienby
-   brown - bear
-   red - lesbian
-   orange - aroace
-   yellow - pan
-   lime - agender
-   green - aromantic
-   cyan - gay man
-   light blue - trans
-   blue - bisexual
-   purple - enby
-   magenta - ace
-   pink - genderfluid
